HELP_FAQ_A_HUB: A Hub is a collaborative workspace for a team, project or client. Each Hub keeps its members, content and permissions separate.
HELP_FAQ_Q_ACCOUNT_VS_HUB: What's the difference between my Account, my Organization, a Hub and a folder?
HELP_FAQ_A_ACCOUNT_VS_HUB: Account is your personal identity and login credentials. Organization is your company or team boundary, where members, billing, domain and organization-level policies are managed. Hub is a collaborative workspace for a team, project or client — each Hub keeps its members, content and permissions separate. Folder is a contextual collaboration space inside a Hub, where files and related conversations or activities stay together.
HELP_FAQ_Q_INVITE_TEAMMATE: How do I invite a teammate?
HELP_FAQ_A_INVITE_TEAMMATE: From inside a Hub, use the Invite button in the top bar: enter the person's email, assign their role, and click Invite. You can also open the workspace you want to invite them to, select Settings in the workspace toolbar, then enter the email, assign a role and click Invite. If they do not have a Drumee account, they will receive a sign-up link. See the Product tour for a step-by-step guide.
HELP_FAQ_Q_EMPTY_WORKSPACE: I just signed up and the workspace is empty — what's first?
HELP_FAQ_A_EMPTY_WORKSPACE: Create your first workspace, upload a file, then invite one teammate. That's the fastest path to seeing Drumee actually work. See the Product tour for a step-by-step guide.
HELP_FAQ_Q_MULTIPLE_HUBS: Can I belong to more than one Hub?
HELP_FAQ_A_MULTIPLE_HUBS: Yes. If several organization owners invite you to their Hubs, you can switch between them anytime — each Hub keeps its own files, chat and permissions separate.
HELP_FAQ_Q_CHAT_SEPARATE: Is chat separate from my files?
HELP_FAQ_A_CHAT_SEPARATE: No — chat lives inside the folder it belongs to. There's no separate chat app to open.
HELP_FAQ_Q_EDIT_DOCS: Can I edit documents without downloading them?
HELP_FAQ_A_EDIT_DOCS: Yes, via the built-in OnlyOffice integration — open and edit directly in the browser.
HELP_FAQ_Q_SHARE_EXTERNAL: How do I share a file with someone outside my organization?
HELP_FAQ_A_SHARE_EXTERNAL: First make sure the file sits in an External Workspace — an Internal Workspace will not allow sharing outside the organization. Then create a share link for the workspace or file and define what the recipient can do: view, download, upload or comment. You can also add an expiry date, password or access limit. A Drumee account is not required for link-based access.
HELP_FAQ_Q_WORKSPACE_PERMISSIONS: Can I control who sees what inside a workspace?
HELP_FAQ_A_WORKSPACE_PERMISSIONS: Yes — permissions are set per workspace and folder with role-based access. Exactly which roles are available depends on your plan.
HELP_FAQ_Q_VERSION_HISTORY: If I delete or overwrite a file, can I get an old version back?
HELP_FAQ_A_VERSION_HISTORY: Yes, on paid plans. The version history retention window depends on your plan tier.
HELP_FAQ_Q_SELF_HOST_TIME: How long does self-hosting take to set up?
HELP_FAQ_A_SELF_HOST_TIME: Under 10 minutes following the self-hosting toolkit. See the Self-hosting setup section for the full walkthrough.
HELP_FAQ_Q_SELF_HOST_NEEDS: What do I need to self-host?
HELP_FAQ_A_SELF_HOST_NEEDS: A Linux server with sufficient storage, running Docker Engine with Docker Compose v2. Drumee also supports native Debian or Ubuntu deployment.
HELP_FAQ_Q_SELF_HOST_BUNDLED: Does self-hosting include DNS, mail and TLS out of the box?
HELP_FAQ_A_SELF_HOST_BUNDLED: TLS certificate provisioning is bundled into the deployment. DNS is optional, and outbound mail requires your own SMTP relay.
HELP_FAQ_A_OPEN_SOURCE: Yes — AGPLv3. The full codebase spans around 50 public repositories at github.com/drumee, covering the server, the UI and the deployment tooling.
HELP_FAQ_Q_MIGRATE_SELF_HOST: Can I move from the cloud (SaaS) version to my own self-hosted instance later, without losing data?
HELP_FAQ_A_MIGRATE_SELF_HOST: Yes, that path exists — workspace data, permissions and file structure are meant to carry over.
HELP_FAQ_Q_SELF_HOST_PLUGINS: Can I add plugins to my self-hosted instance?
HELP_FAQ_A_SELF_HOST_PLUGINS: Yes — the plugin architecture is built for it. Check the Marketplace for what's currently available.
HELP_FAQ_Q_DATA_LOCATION: Where does my data actually live?
HELP_FAQ_A_DATA_LOCATION: On the SaaS version it lives on Drumee's servers, so you are trusting Drumee to hold it. On a self-hosted install it lives entirely on your own infrastructure, and Drumee never touches it.
HELP_FAQ_A_PERMISSIONS_ENFORCED: At the filesystem level, not just inside the app, and default-deny by design: access has to be explicitly granted rather than explicitly blocked.
HELP_FAQ_Q_AUDIT_LOG: Is there an audit log of who accessed what?
HELP_FAQ_A_AUDIT_LOG: Yes. Member, Storage and Audit Log activity are tracked in the Admin console and can be exported, scoped to access, identity and data-exposure events. Full Member, Storage and Audit Log access requires the Business plan.
HELP_FAQ_A_GDPR: Self-hosting keeps data inside infrastructure you control, which supports GDPR data-residency requirements.
HELP_FAQ_Q_PLAN_DIFFERENCE: What's the difference between Free, Team, Business and Sovereign Node?
HELP_FAQ_A_PLAN_DIFFERENCE: See the pricing page for a full comparison, or open Upgrade plan in the sidebar.
HELP_FAQ_Q_STORAGE_LIMIT: What happens if I go over my storage limit?
HELP_FAQ_A_STORAGE_LIMIT: You'll get a notification when you try to upload more files. From there you can either upgrade your plan or free up space.
HELP_FAQ_Q_MIGRATE_BILLING: Can I move from SaaS to self-hosted without losing my data or paying twice?
HELP_FAQ_A_MIGRATE_BILLING: Yes — it uses the same migration path described under Self-hosting above: workspace data, permissions and file structure carry over.
HELP_FAQ_Q_CANCEL_DOWNGRADE: How do I cancel or downgrade?
HELP_FAQ_A_CANCEL_DOWNGRADE: To cancel, go to Settings and click Manage billing. Your cancelled plan stays active until its end date. To downgrade, open Upgrade plan, choose the plan you want and check out as usual. Note that a downgrade takes effect immediately and your current plan becomes inactive, without a refund.
HELP_FAQ_A_MOBILE_APP: Not yet. Drumee runs fully in the browser — there's no native iOS, Android or desktop app right now, but it does work in mobile browsers.
HELP_FAQ_A_BROWSERS: Drumee works across multiple browsers. We recommend Google Chrome for the best experience.
HELP_FAQ_Q_CALENDAR_TASKS: Does Drumee have calendar, contacts or task management?
HELP_FAQ_A_CALENDAR_TASKS: Yes. Every workspace carries the full collaboration stack: Files, Task tracker, Meeting, Chat and Permission. A calendar view is available for both Task tracker and Meeting.
HELP_FAQ_Q_LOGIN_ISSUE: I can't log in, or my invite link doesn't work — what do I do?
HELP_FAQ_A_LOGIN_ISSUE: Reach out through the Contact Support links at the bottom of this page.
HELP_FAQ_Q_REPORT_BUG: Where do I report a bug or request a feature?
HELP_FAQ_A_REPORT_BUG: Report bugs and feature requests to Drumee through the Telegram support channel.
